Pizza Dough Baker's Percentage

Pizza Dough is mixed from 500 g of flour at 65% water, no starter, 2.5% salt, and 0.3% yeast. Divide into balls and rest them until they stretch without snapping back.

How to scale

Recipe

Flour
500 g
Water
325 g
Starter
0 g
Salt
12.5 g
Yeast
1.5 g
Total dough
839 g

Effective hydration 65%

Percentages are of the flour you weigh out, and effective hydration also counts the flour and water inside a starter that is itself 100% hydration.

Enter a flour weight above zero, or a ball count and grams per ball above zero. Percentages cannot be negative.
